newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU industrial investment seen up 3 percent in 1997.
newsitem.headline: EU industrial investment seen up 3 percent in 1997.

text.p: Industrial investment in the European Union is set to rise by 3 percent in real terms this year, down from 4 percent in 1996, the European Commission said Monday.
However, investment is expected to vary widely across the EU, according to a survey of the manufacturing industry conducted last October and November.
Industrialists in Greece were most optimistic, planning to boost their real investments by 33 percent in 1997, the commission said in a report of the survey.
Finland and Luxembourg were at the other end of the scale, intending to curtail investments by 18 percent.
Figures for other countries planning to increase investment were: the Netherlands 22 percent, Britain 14, Spain 9, Austria 8, Belgium 8, Denmark 6.
Figures for those planing to reduce investment were France, Italy and Germany all 1 percent, Portugal 6, Sweden 8 and Ireland 9.
